step1_analysis.circuit_type: PFET Source Follower (Level Shifter) with NFET Active Load
step1_analysis.description: The circuit consists of a PFET source follower (XM1) that shifts the input voltage up, and an NFET current sink (XM2) that acts as an active load for the preceding stage. In the context of a 1-V op-amp, this level shifter is likely used to adjust the DC common-mode voltage to properly drive subsequent stages or switches that are otherwise difficult to turn on at low supply voltages.

paper_reference.title: A 1-V 10-MHz Clock-Rate 13-Bit CMOS Modulator Using Unity-Gain-Reset Opamps

level_shift.description: DC voltage shift from input to output

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming a 50uA bias current: Vsg = |Vthp| + sqrt(2*Id / (up*Cox * W/L)) = 0.42 + sqrt(2*50u / (50u * 10)) = 0.867 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the SKY130 PMOS parameters and a standard 50uA test bias.

sky130_expected.calculation: Source follower gain is slightly less than 1 (0 dB) due to body effect and channel length modulation.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard source follower behavior; the 80 dB paper metric applies to the entire multi-stage op-amp, not this single buffer.

delay.description: Transient propagation delay from input to output

sky130_expected.calculation: Slew rate = I/C = 50uA / 3.5pF = 14.3 V/us. For a 0.3V swing, delay is ~21ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the bias current and the 3.5pF load capacitance reported in the paper.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC level shift, AC gain, transient delay, and power consumption of the PFET source follower.
step3_testbench.spice:
* PFET Source Follower Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 GND V2 V1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 GND LABEL_NET_2 V2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

* DC Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9

* Input signal at V2 (DC=0.5V, AC=1V, Pulse for Tran)
Vin V2 0 DC 0.5 AC 1 PULSE(0.2 0.8 5n 1n 1n 100n 200n)

* Bias current for the source follower (V1)
Ibias VDD V1 50u

* Load capacitance (from paper)
Cload V1 0 3.5p

.control
  * DC Operating Point Analysis
  op
  let v_out_dc = v(V1)
  let v_in_dc = v(V2)
  let level_shift = v_out_dc - v_in_dc
  let power = -i(VVDD)*1.8 - i(Vin)*0.5
  print level_shift power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 10 1k 100meg
  let gain_db = vdb(V1)
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1k
  meas ac gain_50k find gain_db at=50k
  meas ac gain_10mhz find gain_db at=10.24meg

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 1n 200n
  * Expected DC output is ~1.37V for 0.5V input
  meas tran delay_rise trig v(V2) val=0.5 rise=1 targ v(V1) val=1.37 rise=1
  meas tran delay_fall trig v(V2) val=0.5 fall=1 targ v(V1) val=1.37 fall=1
  meas tran v1_max max v(V1)
  meas tran v1_min min v(V1)
  let v1_swing = v1_max - v1_min
  print v1_swing
  
  quit
.endc
.end
